description: Plain-English descriptions and the InvoiceDraft each must produce. Company context for every case: Northwind, default currency EUR, default tax 20%, clients Acme GmbH, Blue Harbor Ltd, Kappa Studio.

cases.name: hours at a rate plus a flat fee
cases.text: Invoice Acme GmbH for 12 hours of consulting at 150 an hour and a 300 setup fee

cases.name: days, discount, another currency and a note
cases.text: Blue Harbor Ltd: 3 days of on-site training at 900 per day, 10% off, payable in GBP. Add a note that travel is billed separately.

cases.name: client name in lower case
cases.text: bill kappa studio 2 logo concepts at 400 each

cases.text: Invoice Globex for 5 hours of support at 120

cases.text: Kappa Studio, 8 hours of design at 95 with the usual tax, and a 50 euro courier charge with no tax
